title: Vacancy Reset Scheduler
oneLiner: A property turnover operations board that compresses vacancy days by coordinating cleaning, repairs, photos, and vendor handoffs.
targetUser: Small property managers, coliving operators, and turnover coordinators handling vendor-heavy unit resets.
keyUX: See which unit turnovers are blocked, rebalance vendor assignments, and compress days-to-ready before the next move-in.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop field-operations dashboard called Vacancy Reset Scheduler for small property managers and coliving operations teams. It should help teams shorten vacancy days by coordinating cleaning, repair, inspection photos, listing prep, and vendor assignment for each unit turnover. Include a vacancy-days KPI hero, a unit turnover pipeline, a task-stage timeline, a vendor assignment board, a blockers and rework panel, and a move-in readiness rail. Design direction: use a field-ops aesthetic with off-white, slate, moss green, and safety orange accents; keep status visibility strong, task movement obvious, and the product rugged, dependable, and crew-friendly.
